body:
99.9% of companies fail in the mind of the entrepreneur.

So many people have ideas that never become real, because they can’t quit their jobs to start something with no guidance, no firm idea and no backing.

Ascend, Mesa’s Hybrid PGP in Business, AI & Entrepreneurship, lets you build your business on the side, without quitting. 12 months of weekends. For professionals with 5+ years of experience. Apply now.
headline: No need to quit your job
